powerName: Arrest a person where the statutory reason-to-believe condition is met
description: Section 9(2)(c) states that an authorised officer may arrest a person whom the officer has reason to believe has committed the offence described in Section 9(2).
conditions: The officer must be the authorised officer referred to in Section 9(1).
The Section 9(2) reason-to-believe condition must be met.
Section 9(4)(b) requires the arrested person to be informed of the grounds and produced before the Magistrate without unnecessary delay.
limitations: This record does not answer whether arrest is lawful in a particular situation.
This record is not an arrest instruction.
source: India Code, Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
